title: [main] NO SAF-T changes imported category identifier casing and does not show full identifiers in mapping setup
summary: Norwegian SAF-T now preserves original category identifiers during import and displays them in the mapping setup to prevent uppercase conversion issues and improve identifier visibility.
key_points: Original category identifiers are preserved for all imported categories, not just those exceeding 20 characters
New read-only Category Extended No. column added to SAF-T G/L Mapping Subpage to display the full identifier
Category extended number refreshes when selecting or clearing a category on the mapping page
Existing category keys and account mappings remain unchanged, only reimport needed to repair short categories
24 unit tests added to cover import, reimport, mapping page, and XML export scenarios
quote: Preserve the original identifier for all imported categories and show it in a read-only Category Extended No. column.
